review_candidates.description: Job Title : Dynamics 365 CRM Engineer Job Location : Cairo, Egypt As a Dynamics 365 CRM Engineer at Accenture, you will be responsible for developing and customizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) solutions and Power Platform components to meet client requirements. You will implement technical designs, extend platform capabilities, and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with Microsoft best practices. Automate business processes using Power Automate. Work with Dataverse for entity modeling, relationships, business rules, and security roles. Quality & Governance Adhere to coding standards and participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality deliverables. Ensure compliance with security, data governance, and performance guidelines. review_candidates.title: Field Services Engineer
review_candidates.location: Markaz El Sadat, Al Minufiyah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Field Service Engineer – Citrus Optical Sizing & Potato Steam Peeling lines Position Summary We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on Field Service Engineer to support the installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of citrus optical sizing equipment and potato steam peeling processing lines. The ideal candidate will have strong electro-mechanical troubleshooting skills, experience with industrial automation systems, and the ability to work directly with customers in food processing environments. Key Responsibilities •Install, commission, test, and optimize citrus optical sizing machines and potato steam peeling systems at customer sites. •Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, calibration, and emergency repairs on electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and PLC-controlled systems. •Diagnose and troubleshoot system issues involving sensors, cameras, conveyors, steam systems, valves, motors, drives, and control panels. •Support integration of equipment with existing food processing and packing line operations. •Configure and tune optical inspection and sorting systems to maximize product quality, throughput, and operational efficiency. •Assist customers with machine operation, process optimization, and reduction of product waste and downtime. •Read and interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, P&IDs, and PLC documentation. •Provide on-site technical training and support to operators, maintenance teams, and plant personnel. •Prepare service reports, maintenance documentation, and technical recommendations following service visits. •Collaborate with engineering and technical support teams to resolve complex field issues. •Represent the company professionally while building strong customer relationships. Qualifications & Experience •Bachelor’s degree in mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering. •3–5 years of field service experience in citrus packhouses, food processing systems, or automated production lines. •Experience working with citrus optical sizing equipment, potato steam peeling systems, grading/sorting machines, or food processing machinery is strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of: •PLC systems and industrial automation •Electrical power and control circuits •Sensors, instrumentation, and motor controls •Pneumatic and hydraulic systems •Mechanical assemblies and conveyor systems •Ability to troubleshoot electrical and mechanical faults independently in the field. •Familiarity with HMI systems, VFDs, industrial networking, and control panels is an advantage. •Ability to read and understand technical schematics and engineering drawings. •Excellent problem-solving and customer service skills. •Strong communication skills and ability to work with multicultural teams and customers. •Willingness to travel extensively (up to 60–70%) domestically. •Valid driver’s license and owns a car. Physical & Work Environment Requirements •Ability to work in food processing plants, packing houses, farms, and industrial environments. •Comfortable working in hot, humid, cold, wet, and confined-space conditions when required. •Ability to stand, bend, kneel, climb ladders, and lift service tools/equipment. •Ability to travel frequently and respond to customer service needs on short notice. •Must be able to distinguish wiring and indicator colors accurately. •Must follow all food safety, plant safety, and PPE requirements. Preferred Skills •Experience with optical sorting technology, machine vision systems, or steam processing equipment. •Knowledge of food industry sanitation and hygiene standards. •Experience with commissioning and startup of industrial processing lines. •Familiarity with remote diagnostics and technical reporting systems. • Multilingual communication skills are a plus.

review_candidates.title: Platform Security Manager
review_candidates.job_function: Project Management, General Business, and Management
review_candidates.description: About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, song, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. We combine unmatched experience and specialized capabilities across more than 40 industries – powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. With 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture brings continuous innovation to help clients improve their performance and create lasting value across their enterprises. Visit us at www.accenture.com. Accenture Security Join Accenture Security to pioneer security solutions that blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and managed services. Using the coolest next-gen tech, you’ll have every chance to stay one step ahead of cybercrime and out-hack the hackers. Accenture Security provides comprehensive security services – from security strategy development to business transformation, to managed security services – on demand and at a global scale to help mitigate risks and take full advantage of advanced technologies and proven risk management models. Our experienced team of global security professionals helps businesses understand their risks and build resilience from the inside out, giving them the confidence to focus on what matters most: innovation and business growth. We are looking for a Senior Manager, SAP Security to drive the growth of our SAP Security practice across EMEA. This role is ideal for someone with a strong mix of business development, solution architecture, and technical delivery expertise. You will play a critical role in expanding our sales pipeline, winning deals, and scaling our team, while ensuring we continue to deliver high-quality SAP security solutions. What You’ll Do: Growth & Sales Develop and execute lead generation strategies to expand our SAP Security pipeline. Lead pre-sales efforts, including client engagement, bid development, and proposal creation. Qualify leads and shape solutions that align with client needs, balancing security, business objectives, and cost-effectiveness. Price deals effectively and develop competitive commercial models. Drive internal marketing and awareness of our SAP Security offerings across the wider organization. Build and maintain trusted client relationships, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Collaborate with global teams to refine service offerings and leverage existing capabilities. Solution Architecture & Delivery Design and architect end-to-end SAP Security and GRC solutions, covering on-premises and cloud environments. Provide technical leadership on projects, ensuring secure and scalable SAP implementations. Oversee security assessments, roadmap development, and remediation planning. Innovate by automating security processes and introducing new methodologies. Lead teams to successfully deliver projects on time and within budget. Hiring & Team Expansion Define and execute a hiring strategy to build a high-performing SAP Security team. Lead recruitment efforts, identifying and attracting top talent. Act as a mentor and people leader, fostering growth and professional development within the team. What You Bring: Proven experience in SAP Security, GRC, and Solution Architecture with a strong commercial mindset. Track record of winning new business, growing sales, and driving revenue within a consulting or services environment. Ability to price, structure, and staff deals effectively. Strong client-facing and relationship-building skills. Experience leading and delivering complex SAP Security projects. Knowledge of SAP GRC (Access Control, Process Control, Risk Management), Cloud Security, and Identity & Access Management. Ability to work across multiple industries (e.g., oil & gas, manufacturing, finance) and adapt solutions accordingly. Fluency in English; an additional European language is a plus. Nice to Have: Experience in SAP BTP Security, IAG, IAS, or other emerging SAP security technologies. Understanding of cloud security principles and cybersecurity frameworks. Strong knowledge of Segregation of Duties (SoD) and risk management best practices. This role is for someone who thrives in both business and technical leadership, combining deep SAP security expertise with the ability to sell, scale, and deliver. Why join us? We offer a transparent, fast paced approach career progression, with a focus on your strengths and continuous coaching from senior colleagues You will benefit from working alongside Accenture experts who are solving some of the biggest industry challenges with innovative thinking and pioneering tools Flexible work arrangements and a range of benefits including competitive rewards You will have access to state-of-the-art technology that will give you the opportunity to deepen your existing skills even as you help create the latest business trends You will also have opportunities to make a difference to the communities in which we work and live Next Steps If this sounds like the ideal role, career and company for you, click below to apply. To learn more about life @AccentureMiddleEast, follow us on social media and keep up with our latest news. Accenture Middle East: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube
